notes: «وقال غيره» starts a second isnad for the same saying (rule 4): its first link is an unnamed «غيره»
both routes repeat Layth and Uqayl, then the text writes Ibn Shihab onward once: shared tail (a reading of the Bukhari convention, not a fixed rule)
the Companion Umar is the last link; the Prophet's words are the saying
